title: Dire wolf carcass found at Dry Gulch Creek and matched by biologist Ben Woodruff
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: right there on camera the team happens upon this carcass of this decomposing large wolf-like creature

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says his team came across the rotting carcass of a large wolf-like animal at Dry Gulch Creek on the ranch, filmed as it happened, sometime in the 2020s. He says a biologist named Ben Woodruff matched it to a dire wolf, a giant wolf long thought extinct, and the find appears in the TV series The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch. Fugal tells it as something he was part of, and if true it would add a creature out of the deep past to the ranch's list of oddities.
